intent: Implement LedgerEventSubscriber making the T1 tests pass, exactly per ast_hints. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. @Component implementing SmartLifecycle. Constructor(TelemetryEventBus, RecordTelemetryService, DeadLetterSink, TelemetryProperties). start subscribes to bus.stream() and calls record per event with flatMap bounded concurrency; each record retried with retryWhen(Retry.backoff(retryMaxAttempts, retryBackoff)); after exhaustion the event goes to DeadLetterSink.reject and the stream continues. Recording is eventual and never blocks intake. stop disposes; isRunning reflects it.
